name: Spring Security
about: Usually comes with Spring Boot: Boot 4.1.3 brings 7.1.3 and Boot 4.0.10 brings 7.0.9.

unfixed.note: No free fix. Spring's fixes (6.5.13, 6.4.20, 5.8.29, 5.7.27) are only for Enterprise support customers.
